_about: Cross-check of which aliens a version of Ben transformed into ON-SCREEN per series, derived from the Known Aliens tables of the device pages (Omnitrix (Original): 'Original/Pre-Reconfigured' = OS, 'Reconfigured' = AF; Ultimatrix (Original): 'Known Unlocked Aliens' + 'Known Ultimate Forms' = UA; Omnitrix (Omniverse): 'Unlocked Aliens' = OV; plus Biomnitrix 'Accessed on-screen' fusions for OV Ben 10,000 and the OS Combinations table), then filtered against each alien page's Appearances section. Table entries that were unlocked but never used on-screen in that era are listed under notes, not in the lists. Only TV episodes and canonical movies count (video games/comics excluded).

notes: OS: Feedback is in the original-Omnitrix table (unlocked off-screen after Destroy All Aliens) but was only ever seen in Omniverse flashbacks - no OS appearance. Clockwork's table entry (temporarily unlocked in Ben Again) is an OV event. Ken's transformations in Ken 10 (Buzzshock, Spitter, Wildvine, Grey Matter, XLR8 etc.) are by Ken, not a Ben. Non-canon Gwen 10 / Goodbye and Good Riddance uses ignored.

OS: Arctiguana, Spitter and Buzzshock appear in OS only as Ben 10,000's transformations (ben-10k-os); Spitter and Buzzshock are not on the original-Omnitrix table at all (Ben 10,000's future Omnitrix), so they were added from the Ben 10,000 / alien pages.

AF: Heatblast (reunlocked off-screen before Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 1 - hologram only) and Wildmutt (reunlocked via Master Control in War of the Worlds: Part 1) were never used on-screen in Alien Force. Ultimate Humungousaur appeared in AF only via Albedo (The Final Battle: Part 1) - not a Ben appearance. Albedo's use of Ben's forms in AF (Good Copy, Bad Copy; The Final Battle) do not create AF appearances.

UA: Ultimatrix table entries never used on-screen in UA: Arctiguana, Blitzwolfer, Ditto, Eye Guy, Frankenstrike, Grey Matter, Snare-Oh, Wildvine and Perk Upchuck (all reunlocked by Ben 10,000 in Ben 10,000 Returns) and Gravattack (inferred unlocked before Double or Nothing; first used in OV). The wiki says Ben transformed into 35 of the 47 listed on-screen; our per-page filter yields 36 base forms if the three Heroes United-only forms (Shocksquatch, Upgrade, XLR8) and Ripjaws' non-speaking Perplexahedron use are counted - Heroes United is a Generator Rex crossover, so flag whether the project treats it as canonical UA.

UA: 10-year-old Ben (The Forge of Creation, plus Fame TV cameo) used Heatblast, Four Arms, Stinkfly and Wildmutt = ben-10-ua. Ben 10,000 (UA) used Ultimate Ben in Ben 10,000 Returns = ben-10k-ua. Gwen and Kevin used Ben's forms in Inspector 13 (not Bens). Chromastone was destroyed in Enemy of My Frenemy but remained available; Alien X was locked after The Forge of Creation.

OV: table entries never used on-screen in Omniverse: Chamalien (no OV appearances), Fasttrack (only mentioned as an 'intended alien') and Jetray (photos only in Return to Forever). The wiki states 63 named aliens with 59 used at least once.

OV: 'by 11-year-old Ben' labels cover three different situations - genuine flashbacks (Feedback, Four Arms, XLR8, Diamondhead, Cannonbolt, Stinkfly, Heatblast, Eye Guy, Way Big, Upchuck, Upgrade, Wildmutt, Wildvine), the Ben Again body-swap (11-year-old mind in 16-year-old body: Arctiguana, Armodrillo, Big Chill, Clockwork, Diamondhead, Goop, NRG, Wildmutt; and 16-year-old mind in 11-year-old body: Ditto, Wildvine, Clockwork), and present-day Ben de-aged by Billy Billions in Arrested Development (Bloxx, Ball Weevil, Diamondhead). Special Delivery has a 15-year-old Ben flashback using Big Chill (no ben-15 OV id in the spec). And Then There Was Ben has 10-year-old Ben using Heatblast (ben-10-ov).

OV: Ultimate forms in Omniverse were used only by Albedo (Ultimate Humungousaur, Ultimate Spidermonkey, Ultimate Gravattack, Ultimate Arctiguana, Ultimate Rath, plus Ultimate Albedo) - no Ben OV appearance for any Ultimate. Alternate Bens (Bad Ben, Mad Ben, Nega Ben, Benzarro, Gwen 10, No Watch Ben, Ben 23, Anur-Mirrored Ben) and Skurd's borrowed alien parts do not create appearances.

OV Ben 10,000 (ben-10k-ov) used only Biomnitrix fusions on-screen (Fourmungousaur, Atomic-X, Crashocker, Uprigg, Big Chuck, Humungoopsaur), taken from the Biomnitrix page's 'Accessed on-screen' table; he did not use any single alien on-screen in OV.
